decision_algebra: ANY DENY > ANY INDETERMINATE > ALL PASS

theorem.statement: An AK/EK lineage claim is admissible only when the observed EK, observed AK, AK parent Qualified Name, non-migratable AK attributes, independently bound EK credential material, and TPM credential activation evidence all agree on one session and one TPM identity.
steps: The AK Qualified Name is recomputed from the observed EK Qualified Name and observed AK Name using the AK Name algorithm.

The public-name coherence verifier and AK public-attributes verifier are independent prerequisites; lineage re-executes the latter and requires its exact public-area digest and Name to agree with the AK identity.
AK fixedTPM and fixedParent must both be SET; a migratable AK is not platform lineage evidence.

AK public material and AK Name must be recorded from the same TPM ReadPublic context observation; this is a composition binding, not a claim that the verifier independently re-marshals the complete TPMT_PUBLIC structure.
EK credential material must be independently appraised and explicitly bound to the exact observed EK public digest.
Credential activation must use TPM2_MakeCredential and TPM2_ActivateCredential semantics with an externally supplied challenge bound to the exact EK public material and AK Name.

ReferenceModelOnly may model activation secret equality for deterministic testing; OfflineBundle may never promote a stored activation receipt to live proof; the static verifier intentionally grants no PASS for LiveVerifierSession.

required_input.tpm_identity_digest: sha256 digest identifying the capture TPM context

activation_scopes.ReferenceModelOnly: Deterministic semantic model; may compare expected_secret_sha256 with activated_secret_sha256 and is bounded by the ReferenceModelOnly ceiling.
activation_scopes.OfflineBundle: Stored receipt is never self-authenticating; verifier returns INDETERMINATE until independently authenticated.
activation_scopes.LiveVerifierSession: Reserved for a future verifier that itself executes TPM2_ActivateCredential against the live TPM; this static verifier intentionally returns INDETERMINATE.

future_live_capture_requirements: capture EK public, EK Name, and EK Qualified Name from the same TPM context
create or load AK under the EK and record AK public, AK Name, AK Qualified Name, and fixedTPM/fixedParent attributes
obtain EK credential material from a qualified provider or TPM-resident credential source and bind it to the exact EK public digest
obtain an externally supplied challenge and run TPM2_MakeCredential against the observed EK public and AK Name
execute TPM2_ActivateCredential using the TPM-resident AK and EK contexts
retain hashes and provenance of the activation transcript without requiring the plaintext credential secret to remain in the evidence bundle
compose the lineage result with later TPM Quote verification over the exact same AK public material
